features: 10000 mAh Capacity with Smart Power Management: Stay powered all day with the EnergyShroom PB300 Neo 10000mAh power bank, capable of charging your smartphone up to 2–3 times on a single charge, so you don’t run out of battery when you need it most. Its Smart Power Management intelligently distributes power to connected devices, helping prevent unnecessary energy loss, so every charge lasts longer and works smarter for you.

3x Output Ports & 2x Input Ports: With three output ports (2x USB-A, 1x Type-C 2-Way) and two input ports (Micro USB and Type-C 2-Way), EnergyShroom PB300 Neo lets you power up multiple devices simultaneously. No more waiting for your turn, charge your phone, tablet, & smartwatch all at once. Perfect for airports, road trips, or remote work, stay powered up without hunting for extra sockets.

Blazing-Fast 22.5W 2-Way Charging: Experience ultra-fast charging with QC 3.0 Power Delivery (PD), and Programmable Power Supply (PPS). Whether you need a quick boost before heading out or a full charge overnight, this power bank delivers efficient & rapid energy transfer to keep you moving.

Pass Through Charging: Why choose between charging your power bank or your devices? With pass-through charging, power up your phone while the EnergyShroom PB300 Neo itself recharges, ensuring you're never out of battery when you need it most—ideal for travel & work setups.

12-Layer Smart IC Protection: Equipped with advanced 12-layer circuitry, this power bank protects against short circuits, overheating, overcharging, & over-discharging. Designed for longevity, it safeguards your devices while optimising their charging efficiency.
